appointments.label: Appointments
appointments.hint: Upcoming and past visits, and which doctors

journey.label: Pregnancy journey
journey.hint: Week, due date, baby's growth and the visit plan

reports.label: Reports
reports.hint: Test reports and their checked values

notifications.label: Send updates
notifications.hint: Reminders and new summaries, for the things above

join.title: Follow a family member
join.subtitle: Enter the code she shared with you, and tell us who you are to her.
join.codeHint: Six letters and numbers, like K7M-Q2P
join.codeInvalid: Enter all 6 characters of the code
join.relationRequired: Please choose how you are related
join.codeRejected: That code is not valid, or it has expired. Please check it or ask for a new one.

notice.rejected: Your last request was declined. You can try again with a new code.
notice.revoked: Your access was ended. To follow again, ask for a new code.

waiting.title: Waiting for approval
waiting.message: Your request has been sent. This screen updates by itself as soon as it is approved.
waiting.cancelMessage: You will need a new code to ask again.

people.title: People you follow
people.leaveMessage: You will no longer see updates for {{name}}. You will need a new code to follow again.
people.emptyTitle: You are not following anyone yet
people.emptyMessage: Ask your family member for her GARBH code to get started.

home.title: Home
home.switch: Switch person or manage who you follow
home.nothingShared: She has not shared any details with you yet. You can ask her to turn some on.

journey.babySize: The baby is about the size of a {{size}}.

appointments.emptyMessage: Appointments will show up here once they are booked.

summaries.emptyMessage: Summaries appear here after the doctor has checked them.

reports.emptyMessage: Reports appear here once they are added.

prescriptions.emptyMessage: Medicines prescribed by the doctor appear here.

my.title: My companions
my.intro: Family members you invite can follow your pregnancy. You choose what each person can see, and you can stop sharing at any time.
my.emptyMessage: Invite a family member with a code. They ask to join, and you decide what they see.
my.unverifiedMessage: Please visit the hospital desk with a photo ID to verify your account. After that you can invite family members here.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.intro: Make a code and send it to your family member. It works once and expires in 24 hours.
invite.onceNote: For your safety the code is shown only here, once. Leaving this screen keeps it, but closing the app does not.
invite.shareMessage: Join me on GARBH to follow my pregnancy. Install the app, choose "I'm a family member" and enter this code: {{code}} (valid for 24 hours).
invite.newCodeHint: A new code stops the old one from working.
invite.lostCode: You made a code earlier. For safety it can only be seen once. Make a new code to see it again.
invite.expired: That code has expired. Make a new one.
invite.used: Someone used your code and is waiting for your approval.

request.title: Review request
request.intro: {{name}} ({{relation}}) wants to follow your pregnancy. Choose what they can see. You can change this any time.
request.declineMessage: They will not get access. They would need a new code to ask again.
request.closed: This request is no longer open.

detail.title: Companion
detail.stopMessage: {{name}} will lose access straight away. You can invite them again later with a new code.
detail.closed: This person no longer has access.
